يتلعثم (form IIq)
# يَتَلَعْثَمُ (yatalaʕṯamu) /ja.ta.laʕ.θa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَلَعْثَمَ (talaʕṯama)
# يَتَلَعْثَمَ (yatalaʕṯama) /ja.ta.laʕ.θa.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَلَعْثَمَ (talaʕṯama)
# يَتَلَعْثَمْ (yatalaʕṯam) /ja.ta.laʕ.θam/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَلَعْثَمَ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
